# About
Demian Sims is a NYC-based software engineer, TypeScript/React developer, and creative technologist. He builds modern data tools, AI-powered apps, and intuitive web experiences.

# Skills
- Frontend: React, TypeScript, Next.js, Tailwind CSS
- Backend: Node.js, Express, NestJS, Ruby on Rails, GraphQL
- Database: PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis, Prisma, Supabase
- DevOps: Docker, AWS, Vercel, GitHub Actions, CI/CD
- Mobile: React Native, Expo, iOS, Android
- Design: Figma, UI/UX, Responsive Design
- Architecture: Microservices, REST APIs, Event-Driven, Clean Code

# Projects
- AvandarLabs: Client-side data tooling with DuckDB-WASM for analyzing large CSV files without server uploads
- Vigil: PWA for sharing safety alerts with multi-person confirmation system
- Mood Blocks: LLM-powered mood parsing with Web Audio API for visuals and sound
- Music Portfolio: Portfolio site for music and sound design work
- Climate Response: Real-time emissions tracking from industrial sensors and utility feeds
- Faunagram: App for sharing photos and locations of wildlife sightings

# Philosophy
Demian focuses on ownership, mission-driven work, clean scalable code, thinking beyond tickets, and learning/mentorship. He values clarity, ownership, and good product taste.
